chapter_seo_title: Chapter 264 - The Change - Dao Gui Yi Xian Translation
chapter_meta_description: When a timid boy picks up a cursed sword, Li Huowang witnesses the terrifying price of the military path. A quiet chapter with a soul-crushing punch.
og_title: A Soul is Broken for Power
og_description: Li Huowang watches as a normal boy becomes a monster, proving that in this world, every power has a price paid in blood and sanity.
twitter_description: A quiet, chilling chapter where Li Huowang sees the real cost of the military path—the transformation of a timid boy into a vengeful beast.

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful weapon of the “military path” (兵家) that enhances killing ability but corrupts a normal user's personality with overwhelming bloodlust and aggression.
A path of cultivation in the Dao-Twisted World that imbues its followers with immense killing power, but twists their character towards cruelty and violence.
A corrupting force associated with weapons and war; in this world, it fundamentally alters the personality of those exposed to it, leaving only the Heart-Element unaffected.
